messages:
Sara (Sales): Kicking off POC with Lumina Analytics today. They want a 4-week POC for a PHI-aware summarization + extraction pipeline. Need alignment on scope, security, and success metrics. @AJ can you confirm runtime footprint and whether hosted Dedicated is acceptable?
AJ (Eng-SE): quick Q — workload estimate? latency targets? Seq length? With numbers we can size GPUs. For reference: 200 reqs/min peak, avg seq ~512 tokens would map to 2x A10G or a small Dedicated pool.
Mike (Solutions): Lumina sent a sanitized sample to s3 (link posted in DM). They want p95 latency <300ms and F1>0.85 on their NER eval. Also need DPA + SOC2 artifacts for legal before we start ingesting any real data. I'm drafting SOW.
Anna (Security): Important security asks: HIPAA/BAA for PHI, DPA for GDPR, SOC2 Type II report, and pen-test evidence or permission to run a scoped external scan. They also require EU-only data residency for production; are they ok with eu-west-1 for the POC? We need KMS integration and full audit logs enabled.
Sara (Sales): Lumina confirmed EU-only for prod; for POC they can accept EU staging in eu-west-1. They can tokenise PHI for the test dataset but legal still wants a DPA. They're asking whether Redwood can sign a BA for POC.
AJ (Eng-SE): BA usually means Private deployment or Dedicated under a contract. For hosted POC we can offer Dedicated capacity in eu-west with customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key). Tech recommendation for perf: quantized model + prefix KV caching. Example config we plan to test:
```yaml
model: redwood/open-llama-7b
quantization: int8
batch_size: 8
kv_cache: true
region: eu-west-1
```
This should hit latency targets for the sample size.
Mike (Solutions): Pricing ask from Lumina: can we offer a 4-week POC package (discounted) + one week of Dedicated trial for integration? They also want guaranteed burst capacity at certain windows. I'll draft pricing; need finance signoff on discount.
Anna (Security): Pen-test note: we can share our latest redacted pen-test summary and SOC2 Type II report. We typically don't allow full external pen-tests against hosted network without contract terms; alternative is to scope an app-layer external scan only. I'll have Legal prepare the DPA and BA template options.
POC-Bot: Uploaded: DPA draft (drive.redwood/dpa-lumina), SOC2-redacted (drive.redwood/soc2-redacted), BA-template (drive.redwood/ba-template).
Sara (Sales): Action items and timeline: 1) AJ to run smoke perf test against sanitized s3 subset (tomorrow). 2) Anna to prepare DPA redlines + confirm pen-test stance. 3) Mike to finalize SOW + pricing. Timeline proposed: kickoff this week, integration week 1, evals & prompt tuning weeks 2-3, wrap & decision week 4. Can owners confirm by EOD? :thumbsup:
AJ (Eng-SE): ack. I'll run perf tests and post results + recommended instance SKU by tomorrow noon.
Anna (Security): ack. I'll escalate BA signature question to Legal if the customer insists; otherwise we'll proceed on Dedicated + DPA for POC.
Mike (Solutions): ack — will share SOW draft by EOD for review.
Sara (Sales): thanks team. If we can get the DPA and perf sign-off quickly we can start ingesting the tokenized samples next week and begin evals.
